title: [spec-gap][R-11-040] Python default site mounts legacy /keys resource instead of KeyStoreResource (spec 17.5.5)
description: Spec 17.5.5: GET /keys lists the trust store (iid, pubkey_fp, trust, first_seen, last_seen); GET/PUT/DELETE /keys/<iid> manage individual keys with trust verified -> 2.04, delete -> 2.02. Classification: divergent (Python stack). Evidence: full spec-shaped KeyStoreResource exists (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/keys.py:147-222, trust set includes verified, DELETE returns DELETED, 24 tests in test_keys_resource.py + keystore vectors) but the default build_site() mounts the legacy local-pubkey KeyResource at [keys] instead (site.py:296); keys.py:226-228 itself notes the legacy resource is not the full key store. Suggested placement: swap the [keys] registration in site.py to KeyStoreResource (keep local-pubkey identity under /config/identity), update discovery expectations in tests. C and Rust conform (coap_keys.c:529-540; lichen-client keystore.rs + keystore_iid.json).
